tools.name: powershell
tools.targetPath: $root=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('tf-debug-'+[guid]::NewGuid()); New-Item -ItemType Directory $root | Out-Null; $s=(Resolve-Path './src/TaskForge.ps1').Path; $f=Join-Path $root 'c.json'; & pwsh -NoProfile -File $s add --title Pending --data-file $f | Out-Null; $before=Get-Content $f -Raw; & pwsh -NoProfile -File $s complete --id 1 --data-file $f | Out-Null; & pwsh -NoProfile -File $s undo --data-file $f --json | Out-Null; $after=Get-Content $f -Raw; 'BEFORE:'; $before; 'AFTER:'; $after; Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force
